fields.statement: At dc20d2c6 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-rex-session (PASS), plus the daemon*, run-open*, inbox-open* and root* scripts and go test ./internal/api/... (all PASS). The script builds a root with rhiza root init, registers alpha with rhiza project add and folder with rhiza project add folder --name other, unsets REX_SESSION and fakes rex: rhiza daemon --once creates rex session new rhiza-alpha and rhiza-other exactly once each and never rhiza-folder; each detached run driver line carries REX_SESSION=rhiza-alpha / REX_SESSION=rhiza-other; with both sessions listed by rex session ls a second --once creates none; rhiza run open --run in the renamed project, for a live (locked) run with a recorded tab and no session, issues rex block inspect -s rhiza-other and rex focus -s rhiza-other. Diff read: repoSessionName prefers Ctx.ProjectName (set in newDaemonProj) then the root registry's ProjectOf name, falling back to the folder; run open falls back to it when no session is recorded.
